title: Harry Styles Cancels Together, Together Tour Date in Brazil: Here’s Why
summary: The pop star was due to play the third show of a four-night run in São Paulo on July 21.
contentText:
Harry Styles has canceled a live performance in São Paulo, Brazil, on Tuesday (July 21) due to “tour illness,” Live Nation has confirmed.

Related

Harry Styles Opens Together, Together Tour With Electrifying Amsterdam Show: 7 Best Moments

Guinness World Records Certifies Harry Styles’ Wembley Stadium Run As Venue’s Longest Residency Ever

Harry Styles Grabs Wembley Stadium Crown as Historic Run Begins: 7 Best Moments

The Together, Together tour run first hit the Estádio do MorumBIS with a pair of shows on Friday and Saturday (July 17-18). An upcoming show on Friday (July 24) is set to go ahead as planned; tonight’s show will not be rescheduled, with ticket holders set to be refunded.

“We deeply regret to share that the Harry Styles show on Tuesday, July 21, 2026, at MorumBIS has been canceled due to tour illness,” a message sent to ticket holders read. “Your order will be refunded at point of purchase, per the details outlined below.”

“Friday, July 24, 2026, will play as scheduled. If you would like to attend Friday’s show, you may use your July 21 ticket number to purchase tickets at an exclusive discount starting today, Tuesday, July 21, 2026, at 12 p.m. through Friday, July 24 at 12 p.m. BRT while supplies last. You will still receive your full refund for the Tuesday, July 21, 2026, show.”

The message concluded, “We have worked with the venue to open up as many tickets as possible for Friday’s show, but please note that inventory is extremely limited.”

Styles’ team declined to comment on the cancellation.

São Paulo is the third stop on Styles’ residency-style tour. The Together Together run first kicked off in Amsterdam May 17 with a 10-show stand at the Johan Cruyff Arena. At the tour’s next location in London, Styles broke a Guinness World Record with his 12 sold-out shows at Wembley Stadium. Coldplay previously held the title following its 10 shows at the stadium in 2025.

Following Friday’s show, the Together, Together tour will head to Mexico City July 31 for six shows, before setting up for 30 shows in New York, and a further six in Australia. The tour is set to finish on Dec. 13 in Sydney.
